final_decision.verification_mode: SIGNAL+CI (PSNR invalid for noise severity: independent seed adds both variances; PSNR decreases monotonically with sim noise sigma)
final_decision.rationale: Saturation strengthen dominates the appearance (chroma ratio 2.58, clipping 25%); mean drop is an HSV-clipping artifact, not brightness. Blur gaussian:3 (not glass/2/4/5) reproduces gradient/Laplacian/local-std statistics within 0.01-3.5% on target and wins PSNR differential on pair1. Weak YCrCb noise before blur is required for texture: without it Y/Cr/Cb local std are 43-56% low; YCrCb:3 matches unique-color counts 0-1% and texture 0.01-3.5%. Noise-after-blur ordering and glass blur rejected. No compression (block_boundary 0.994, CI 0%). Verified identically on 4 additional support pairs (CI 10/10 each).

no-noise hypothesis: higher PSNR but Y/Cr/Cb local std 30-56% low; kept in case noise judgment is wrong
